description: This file defines the NetworkManagerClient class in the Aws\NetworkManager namespace, extending the AwsClient class. It provides method annotations for interacting with the AWS Network Manager service, including both synchronous and asynchronous methods for various network resource operations.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Network Manager API, providing methods for network resource management.

methods.name: acceptAttachment
methods.description: Synchronous method to accept a network attachment.

methods.name: acceptAttachmentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous promise-based method to accept a network attachment.

methods.name: associateConnectPeer
methods.description: Synchronous method to associate a connect peer.

methods.name: associateConnectPeerAsync
methods.description: Async version to associate a connect peer.

methods.name: createGlobalNetwork
methods.description: Creates a new global network resource.

methods.name: createGlobalNetworkAsync
methods.description: Async version to create a global network.

methods.name: deleteCoreNetworkAsync
methods.description: Async version to delete a core network.

methods.name: getCoreNetwork
methods.description: Retrieves details about a core network.

methods.name: getCoreNetworkAsync
methods.description: Async version to get core network details.

methods.name: updateGlobalNetworkAsync
methods.description: Async version to update a global network.
